features: 160W Powerful boAt Signature Sound: Transform your living room into an acoustic powerhouse with 160W RMS of total peak output. Tuned to deliver our iconic boAt Signature Sound, this setup delivers thunderous, bone-rattling bass layered with sharp, detailed highs, filling your room with pure dynamic energy for movies, sports, and music tracks alike.

5.1 Channel Surround Sound: Upgrade your home entertainment setup to a true cinema layout with an expansive 5.1 channel matrix. This multidirectional speaker configuration casts rich, spatial audio across your entire living space, ensuring every dramatic movie line, subtle background effect, and musical note wraps around you with stunning realism.

Wired Subwoofer & Dual Rear Satellites: Feel every dramatic explosion and beat with a punchy wired subwoofer paired with twin wired rear satellite speakers. The dedicated bass unit drives deep, chest-thumping low frequencies, while the rear satellites create a true rear-soundstage effect to pull you directly into the center of the action.

Multi-Compatibility (BT v5.3, HDMI ARC, USB, AUX): Link your entire entertainment ecosystem without frustrating input limitations. Featuring rock-solid Bluetooth v5.3 alongside physical HDMI ARC, AUX, and USB ports, this versatile soundbar connects instantly to smart TVs, gaming consoles, laptops, and mobile devices for a seamless setup.

Entertainment EQ Modes (Movie, News, Music): Personalize your acoustic output according to what you are watching. Built-in, expert-tuned Equalizer profiles optimize the frequency profile at the press of a button, enhancing deep bass and surround effects during action films, crisp vocal clarity during news broadcasts, and rich acoustics during music streams.

Master Remote Control: Take effortless command over your home theater setup right from the comfort of your couch. The included full-function remote control puts instant access to master volume adjustments, bass and treble controls, source toggles, and EQ preset switches directly at your fingertips.

Sleek Design and Premium Finish: Elevate your home decor with a modern soundbar chassis. Crafted with a premium textured finish and clean angular lines, it sits comfortably under your television or mounts cleanly on the wall, adding a touch of high-end sophistication to your media center.
description: Bring the magic of the cinema directly to your living space with the boAt Aavante Bar Prime B160, a high-power home theater system built to transform your entertainment experience completely. Delivering a massive 160W of powerful boAt Signature Sound, it fills every corner of your room with chest-thumping bass and glistening clarity. The setup creates a true spatial arena through its 5.1 Channel with Subwoofer & Dual Rear Satellites, wrapping multidirectional sound around your sofa so every movie explosion, stadium roar, and subtle movie score feels like a live theater performance. Integrating the soundbar into your home setup is simple courtesy of wide Multi-Compatibility (BT v5.3, HDMI ARC, USB, AUX). Switching sources is completely hassle-free, whether you want high-speed wireless streaming via Bluetooth v5.3 from your phone or a high-definition single-cable HDMI ARC connection to your smart TV. To ensure every piece of media sounds its absolute best, specialized Entertainment EQ Modes (Movie, News, Music) let you instantly optimize audio output, enhancing dialogue clarity during news segments or boosting bass response for blockbusters.
